name: BIMCV COVID-19+ chest films (IEEE DataPort)
what: chest radiographs, laterals among them, and CTs of COVID-19 patients from the hospitals of the Valencian region (BIMCV COVID-19+), about 389 GB in all
level_truth: none; laterals show the thoracic spine
licence: not recorded; read on the IEEE DataPort page after the login
how_to_get: Sign in to a free IEEE account on the page and read the licence line and the file list.
About 389 GB in all: the owner says whether to take the radiographs alone or all of it; the promoter takes any size the shared volume has room for (the owner's rule of 2026-10-22), as a Slurm job.
source_status: found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; open access on IEEE DataPort (doi:10.21227/w3aw-rv39) behind a free IEEE login; tar.gz parts of about 389 GB in all, radiographs and CTs together
